definition.simple: When water slowly turns into gas without being boiled, like puddles drying up in the sun.
definition.academic: The phenomenon of change of a liquid into vapors at any temperature below its boiling point.

common_misconceptions: Evaporation and Boiling are the exact same thing. (Correction: Boiling happens only at a specific temperature (boiling point) and is a bulk phenomenon, while evaporation happens at any temperature below boiling point and is a surface phenomenon.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask: Why do we spread out clothes to dry them faster? (Hint: Evaporation is a surface phenomenon).
